text: The Patriots face a depleted receiver corps and a compromised offensive line as they head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football against the Bears, with Romeo Doubs now on IR after suffering a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch against the Jets, while A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence following a right high ankle sprain was marred by a career-high three dropped passes in that same win. On the defensive side, the secondary takes a significant hit with cornerbacks Carlton Davis III (neck), Karon Prunty (hamstring), and Channing Canada (hamstring) all ruled out, compounding an already thin situation at the position. The offensive line will also be undermanned after starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and Ben Brown (knee) were ruled out by coach Mike Vrabel, leaving the Patriots to scramble with replacements on a short week. The matchup features an intriguing contrast between two draft-class contemporaries—Drake Maye and Caleb Williams—who have known each other for years through the same football camps and development circles.
